purpose: Classify historical accepted v0.2-v0.5 observables and obsolete live implementation surfaces before one atomic Foundation-v2 production cutover. Historical replay is preserved without retaining a second live semantic mode.

classifications.PRESERVE: The bounded observable survives in the next live semantic path with the same promised meaning.
classifications.INTENTIONAL_DELTA: The next live semantic path deliberately changes or generalizes the historical observable and names explicit Foundation-v2 replacement evidence.
classifications.HISTORICAL_REPLAY_ONLY: The observable remains reproducible only through its immutable historical accepted contract/tests and is not part of the next live semantic path.
classifications.REMOVE_AS_SUPERSEDED: The current live implementation surface is deleted after its consumers migrate; Git history and historical replay artifacts are sufficient compatibility records.

rows.historicalObservable: The accepted v0.2-v0.5 umbrella keeps the exact ten-formula root program and historical ContextFrame/projection-oriented readings.
rows.foundationV2Observable: The next live path uses the distinguished R/O/C/L/U bootstrap and primary ostensive forms ∞ / ♂e / b♀ / b⟼e; historical ten-formula text is not the live root authority.
rows.rationale: Historical releases remain immutable, while Foundation v2 re-derived root semantics from exact occurrences and ostensive self-closure.
rows.liveOwner: docs/theory/Система аксиом МТС.md + exact Foundation-v2 root/bootstrap evidence
rows.cutoverAction: Keep historical files immutable; remove any new-production dependency that treats the ten-formula program as Foundation-v2 semantic authority.
rows.cutoverPrecondition: Versioned Foundation-v2 acceptance contract and integrated conformance are green.

historicalSurface: historical root vocabulary and protocol anchors
rows.historicalObservable: Earlier releases expose root meanings through a larger formal root program and parser/interpreter vocabulary.
rows.foundationV2Observable: R=∞; R=R⟼R; O=O⟼R; C=R⟼C; L=O⟼C; U=C⟼O with ∞/[ /]/1/0 mapped to distinguished exact bootstrap occurrences.
rows.rationale: The live bootstrap is reduced to topology/exact occurrence plus ostensive meaning rather than host parser classes or ContextFrame formulas.
rows.liveOwner: Foundation-v2 exact occurrence substrate and root docs
rows.cutoverAction: Make the five-link bootstrap the only live root bootstrap; historical root program remains replay-only.
rows.cutoverPrecondition: Integrated Foundation-v2 release corpus pins bootstrap occurrences and source mappings.

rows.historicalObservable: Recursive root Anum occurrence-tree grammar and canonical inverse on its accepted domain preserve occurrence-local nodes without structural interning.
rows.foundationV2Observable: The same bounded occurrence-tree structural denotation/inverse remains valid on its accepted root domain; it is not promoted to universal identity for arbitrary shared/cyclic asets.
rows.rationale: Foundation v2 narrows the claim around the accepted recursive domain rather than replacing that domain.
rows.liveOwner: core/anum_recursive_denotation.py on the accepted recursive domain
rows.cutoverAction: Keep the recursive domain implementation/conformance available to the new path without using it as universal graph identity.
rows.cutoverPrecondition: Integrated conformance includes preserved positive vectors and shared/cyclic negative boundary vectors.

rows.historicalObservable: Accepted root boundary precedence and root-opening-collapse behavior are deterministic within historical recursive Anum.
rows.foundationV2Observable: Sequence materialization does not silently rewrite the accepted recursive root boundary/canonical inverse behavior.
rows.rationale: The new sequence effect is additive to the accepted recursive value domain rather than a grammar fork that rewrites old root vectors.
rows.liveOwner: recursive Anum compatibility boundary plus Foundation-v2 materialization layer
rows.cutoverAction: Retain the exact historical boundary vectors in the integrated release corpus.
rows.cutoverPrecondition: Sequence and recursive modes are explicitly separated in versioned conformance.

rows.historicalObservable: Quote remains description-level and relative Anum remains explicitly unsupported/RAW where no accepted semantics exists.
rows.foundationV2Observable: Foundation v2 does not invent relative semantics during cutover and does not collapse quote into sequence materialization.
rows.rationale: Unresolved relative semantics belongs to its own future gate; unsupported must remain explicit rather than guessed.
rows.liveOwner: Anum boundary until a future separately accepted relative contract
rows.cutoverAction: Preserve explicit RAW/unsupported and quote boundaries; no compatibility guessing.
rows.cutoverPrecondition: Integrated corpus includes root/quote/relative contrast.

historicalSurface: pair/root recursive Anum used without a general outer sequence effect
rows.historicalObservable: Historical recursive denotation materializes a bounded value tree but does not specify arbitrary ∞ A B C adjacency materialization as an L4 effect.
rows.foundationV2Observable: Explicit sequence effect materializes a fresh exact occurrence for each selected adjacency and returns nested group results outward as one exact value.
rows.rationale: The original AP-memory sequence semantics is made explicit without pretending the raw/source carrier already contains target relations.
rows.cutoverAction: Use Foundation-v2 sequence materialization for live sequence effects; keep historical recursive denotation for its bounded value domain.
rows.cutoverPrecondition: Integrated conformance covers nested sequence materialization and read-vs-effect separation.

rows.historicalObservable: v0.2-v0.5 interpretation uses explicit/virtual ContextFrame start/end roles and parent ascent semantics.
rows.foundationV2Observable: P=parent⟼current; K=K⟼P; ↑ resolves exact current from the explicitly selected K; no primitive ◁/▷ or hidden parent stack in the new live semantics.
rows.rationale: Context remains explicit but its ontology and deixis are deliberately re-derived as ordinary links.
rows.cutoverAction: Historical replay continues under old versioned contracts; no live Foundation-v2 dispatch to ContextFrame semantics.
rows.cutoverPrecondition: All live parser/interpreter/proof consumers use exact K evidence.

rows.historicalObservable: Current live historical parser/AST/interpreter stack implements ContextFrame, parent ascent and AST-driven execution.
rows.foundationV2Observable: One live source→D/G/T→exact form→K/A replay path owns Foundation-v2 semantics.
rows.rationale: Keeping the old live interpreter behind a version flag or adapter would create two production semantic authorities.
rows.historicalReplayOwner: immutable historical contracts/tests and Git history
rows.cutoverAction: Migrate all live consumers, then delete obsolete semantic parser/AST/interpreter execution path or reduce any surviving syntax code to explicitly non-semantic tooling.
rows.cutoverPrecondition: Consumer inventory is zero for old semantic APIs and the integrated release corpus is green.

rows.historicalObservable: Historical formal notation treats ♀F/F♂ as projection-oriented forms under the accepted v0.2-v0.5 interpreter.
rows.foundationV2Observable: Foundation v2 self-closure is ostensively written ♂e = S=S⟼e and b♀ = E=b⟼E; constructor/project/check/search are directions of relation resolution, not raw glyph opcodes.
rows.rationale: The two notations have different orientation and semantic role and must never be flattened into one preserved projection operator family.
rows.liveOwner: Foundation-v2 ostensive notation + exact structural relation resolution
rows.cutoverAction: Keep old glyph meaning only in historical replay; remove live raw-projection/operator dispatch.
rows.cutoverPrecondition: Source dictionary/resolution and ostensive regression guards are part of the release gate.

historicalSurface: historical self-closed forms and projection notation
rows.historicalObservable: Earlier documents contained self-closure but live exposition/runtime could treat glyph forms as projection/constructor operations.
rows.foundationV2Observable: ∞ / ♂e / b♀ / b⟼e are primary ostensive structural forms; exact occurrence identity remains separate from shape.
rows.rationale: Ostensive structure is foundational; operational behavior belongs to an explicit act and binding evidence.
rows.liveOwner: README + current theory/specs + Foundation-v2 relation resolver
rows.cutoverAction: Preserve the ostensive layer as the reader-facing and semantic invariant while machine APIs remain secondary carriers.
rows.cutoverPrecondition: Ostensive docs contract stays green.

rows.historicalObservable: Independent syntax/Anum occurrences are not globally collapsed merely because they have equal visible structure.
rows.foundationV2Observable: Exact occurrence identity generalizes this principle to every link occurrence, including duplicate same-pole links and multiple self-cycles.
rows.rationale: Foundation v2 strengthens rather than removes the historical anti-collapse principle.
rows.cutoverAction: Retain occurrence-distinction vectors and replace syntax-path identity with exact link occurrence refs.
rows.cutoverPrecondition: No live semantic identity depends on AST path or pair interning.

rows.historicalObservable: Historical equality is local/contextual and avoids unrestricted global rewriting, but is tied to the old parser/ContextFrame/form model.
rows.foundationV2Observable: Pair=member⟼representative; Binding=K⟼Pair; Equal_K(a,b) iff one-hop exact representatives are the same exact occurrence.
rows.rationale: The safe locality boundary survives, while equality evidence is re-derived as an exact link-native relation and explicitly excludes implicit transitivity/substitution/congruence.
rows.cutoverAction: Use only exact K representative evidence in the new live path; historical equality remains replayable only under old versions.
rows.cutoverPrecondition: Integrated negative corpus rejects global shape equality and alias-chain closure.

rows.historicalObservable: Historical lexical definition scopes/opening and OpeningPath replay are host-structured accepted behaviors.
rows.foundationV2Observable: Live definitions are explicit persistent D history effects; old lexical/opening proof relations are not silently used as Foundation-v2 definition semantics.
rows.rationale: Foundation v2 preserves historical proof artifacts without retaining host lexical scope as the live dictionary ontology.
rows.cutoverAction: Keep old opening contracts for replay, migrate live definition consumers to persistent D, then remove host DefinitionEnvironment from live semantics.
rows.cutoverPrecondition: No new-production proof/source path requires historical DefinitionEnvironment.

historicalSurface: historical definition syntax and mutable/lexical host environment
rows.historicalObservable: Definition behavior is represented through parser/DefinitionEnvironment semantics.
rows.foundationV2Observable: `:` is an explicit persistent dictionary effect producing an exact definition occurrence and a new immutable D snapshot after selected source/form resolution.
rows.rationale: Definition state becomes replayable link-native evidence instead of hidden host lexical mutation.
rows.cutoverAction: Make persistent D the sole live definition state path.
rows.cutoverPrecondition: Integrated source/interpreter conformance covers valid and forged definition effects.

rows.historicalObservable: Proof search/artifacts are untrusted inputs while a small independent checker/replay layer is trusted and read-only.
rows.foundationV2Observable: Untrusted search/ranking selects exact evidence; deterministic read-only replay validates exact source/K/T/A/Run evidence.
rows.rationale: This architectural boundary remains sound and is one of the strongest reusable historical decisions.
rows.cutoverAction: Preserve the trust split while migrating checker dependencies to the Foundation-v2 evidence model.
rows.cutoverPrecondition: New release checker has no live dependency on historical semantic interpreter behavior.

rows.historicalObservable: Accepted proof versions expose a bounded set of historical relations whose trusted meaning depends on historical parser/interpreter/definition semantics.
rows.foundationV2Observable: The next live proof surface uses exact T-admitted rules, exact actual acts and exact Run continuity; old proof versions remain replayable as old versions.
rows.rationale: Versioned proof artifacts must not be reinterpreted as Foundation-v2 proofs by changing checker meaning in place.
rows.cutoverAction: Retain historical proof checker only for historical versions or immutable replay tooling; new proof production uses only Foundation-v2 contract.
rows.cutoverPrecondition: A new versioned proof contract is accepted with integrated conformance.

rows.historicalObservable: Source spans, deterministic formatting and useful diagnostics can be reproduced independently of semantic identity.
rows.foundationV2Observable: Formatting/span/diagnostic behavior may remain tooling, but source bytes/content/occurrence plus selected segmentation/D/G/T evidence own semantics.
rows.rationale: Useful UX behavior does not require preserving AST/token classes as ontology.
rows.liveOwner: tooling layer above canonical Foundation-v2 source evidence
rows.cutoverAction: Retain or rewrite diagnostics/formatting only behind explicitly non-semantic interfaces.
rows.cutoverPrecondition: No semantic checker consumes token kind/AST class/path as identity.

rows.historicalObservable: The current historical production path dispatches semantic behavior from host token/AST/operator classes.
rows.foundationV2Observable: Semantic identity comes from exact source occurrence, selected segmentation, scoped D and explicit G/T resolution to exact link forms.
rows.rationale: Host syntax classes may survive only as tooling and cannot remain a second semantic authority.
rows.cutoverAction: Delete semantic token/AST dispatch from the live production path after consumers migrate; keep only clearly tooling-only syntax code if still useful.
rows.cutoverPrecondition: No live source/interpreter/proof consumer requires historical TokenKind/AST semantic dispatch.

historicalSurface: historical v0.3 L4 pair uniqueness/idempotent realize
rows.historicalObservable: One exact pair maps to one live LinkRef and realize_link(start,end) is idempotent in the historical L4 model.
rows.foundationV2Observable: Duplicate same-pole exact occurrences are permitted; explicit materialization creates a fresh occurrence unless a future planner explicitly chooses reuse.
rows.rationale: Pair interning contradicts the exact-occurrence Foundation-v2 substrate and sequence materialization semantics.
rows.cutoverAction: Keep old pair-interning only as historical replay evidence; remove it from new live L4 semantics.
rows.cutoverPrecondition: Persistent exact-occurrence conformance is green and all live consumers expect multiplicity.

rows.historicalObservable: Historical backend work can expose storage handles and pair-centric identity at the implementation boundary.
rows.foundationV2Observable: Persistent identity is dataset-local logical occurrence identity `(lineage, local)`; runtime refs/snapshot slots/physical addresses are distinct layers and duplicate occurrences survive reopen.
rows.rationale: Portable semantic replay cannot use a physical address or snapshot slot as universal identity.
rows.cutoverAction: Use only normalized persistent logical IDs/evidence across reopen and keep physical storage identifiers below semantics.
rows.cutoverPrecondition: Integrated release corpus includes reopen, duplicate, cycle, sharing and fresh-lineage vectors.

rows.historicalObservable: Interpretation/search/replay do not materialize missing links as an implicit side effect.
rows.foundationV2Observable: read/find/enumerate/resolve/replay remain non-materializing; materialize/define/persist transitions are explicit effect-side operations.
rows.rationale: This boundary is essential for associative search and was strengthened by the Anum→AP-memory sequence work.
rows.cutoverAction: Retain as a release veto invariant across every new live layer.
rows.cutoverPrecondition: Negative conformance proves read/replay leaves topology unchanged.

rows.historicalObservable: Historical implementation APIs may expose store-local references whose scope was not always separated from semantic identity in downstream reasoning.
rows.foundationV2Observable: Exact runtime occurrence identity is explicit and local; portable replay/persistence uses explicit mapping and dataset-local logical identity, never raw physical address as MTS identity.
rows.rationale: Exact occurrence identity must survive implementation changes without pretending addresses are cross-store semantic names.
rows.cutoverAction: Remove/document any live API assumption that serializes backend addresses as semantic identity.
rows.cutoverPrecondition: Portable replay vectors pass after handle renumbering/reopen/fresh lineage.

rows.historicalObservable: Machine-readable historical operator/reference table describes typed AST, ContextFrame and historical operator semantics.
rows.foundationV2Observable: A new accepted versioned contract will own live Foundation-v2 semantics; old reference_model.py is historical replay/documentation only.
rows.rationale: Version-bumping the old host operator table would preserve superseded semantic ownership.
rows.liveOwner: future accepted Foundation-v2 contract generated from integrated evidence
rows.cutoverAction: Remove core/reference_model.py from the live semantic path after the new accepted contract exists; retain historical files only where required for replay.
rows.cutoverPrecondition: Versioned integrated Foundation-v2 contract is accepted and all consumers repointed.

cutoverPolicy.nextGateAfterDecision: atomic cutover planning plus versioned integrated release conformance; no downstream repin before explicit acceptance
